$comment: WARN-FIRST ROLLOUT POLICY for the chat-HITL evidence gates (cinatra#2821).
The new gates must not red the epic's
in-flight branches mid-review: they enforce only for branches created after the gate lands,
and the branches that were open at that moment are grandfathered by name.
gateLandedAt IS A CUT, NOT A GUESS. It is set to the day this branch was authored. If the
PR lands later, the merge lane MUST bump it to the merge date -- otherwise a branch created
in between is enforced against a gate that was not on main when its author cut it.
knownFindings grandfathers pre-existing debt ON MAIN by identity, so a branch created after
the cut is not failed for findings it did not create. Each entry names the slice that clears
it. Clearing an entry is a deliberate edit to this file, in the slice that fixes the finding.
knownFindings IS EMPTY, and that is a claim about the tree rather than a default. The two entries it held
-- the S7-era C1 / C2 chat_thread cells -- are CLEARED by cinatra#2791 (S9g): the cells were re-driven
against a live app, every anchor the current contract requires was observed (including the
[data-conversation-list] the S7 run never looked for), the records are in
scripts/ci/chat-hitl-capture-index.json, and the acceptance manifest rows that cited the old names now
cite the new ones. An entry is removed only when the finding it names is gone, never to quiet a gate.
